required_algorithm_contract.total_resource_rule: T_construct + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify + certificate_bytes <= poly(L)

universal_proof_obligations.U1_semantics: For every input F, the produced internal object Q(F) satisfies F in SAT iff Q(F) in SAT_Q.
universal_proof_obligations.U2_totality: The algorithm produces a terminal SAT or UNSAT result on every finite input; no OPEN residue remains.
universal_proof_obligations.U3_polynomial_construction: All normalization, discovery, decomposition and certificate construction are bounded by a fixed polynomial in encoded input length L.
universal_proof_obligations.U4_polynomial_state_space: Every explored exact state family has a proved polynomial cardinality/processing bound; no implicit 2^Omega(n) family is materialized or traversed.
universal_proof_obligations.U5_sat_reconstruction: Every SAT terminal reconstructs an assignment to the original variables and replays every original clause true.
universal_proof_obligations.U6_unsat_completeness: Every UNSAT terminal has a complete exact certificate whose verification is polynomial and whose soundness does not assume the algorithm's conclusion.
universal_proof_obligations.U7_invariance: Semantically irrelevant renaming/order/serialization changes cannot alter the mathematical verdict.
universal_proof_obligations.U8_uniformity: One finite algorithm handles all input lengths; no per-size advice table or target-specific mechanism selection is permitted.
universal_proof_obligations.U9_independent_replay: An independently implemented verifier can rebuild semantics and validate certificates without importing candidate solver logic.
universal_proof_obligations.U10_blindness: Discovery receives no expected verdict, provenance label, mechanism label or hidden target metadata.
universal_proof_obligations.U11_asymptotic_proof: Polynomiality is symbolic and universal, not inferred from finite benchmark performance.
universal_proof_obligations.U12_implication_gate: Only after U1-U11 are proved may GENERAL_SAT_IN_P be promoted; only then may P_EQUALS_NP follow via NP-completeness of SAT.
